Generate a bundle of axons around a centreline

Source: R/axons.R
create_axons.Rd

Draws n_axons streamlines (axons) as the centreline plus a zero-mean functional perturbation, and returns them as a fiber::bundle.

Usage

create_axons(
  centerline,
  n_axons = 30,
  n_basis = 8,
  variance = 0.02,
  autocorrelation = 2,
  radius = NULL,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

centerline

A numeric N x 3 matrix (columns X, Y, Z) giving the mean pathway; see generate_centerline().

n_axons

Number of streamlines (axons) in the bundle.

n_basis

Number of B-spline coefficients per coordinate (smoothness of the perturbation).

variance

Coefficient variance sigma^2 controlling the bundle diameter.

autocorrelation

Positive correlation rate > 0 (space between independent and perfectly coherent streamlines).

radius

Optional axonal radius (scalar or length-N vector).

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility of the draws.

Value

A fiber::bundle of n_axons streamlines.

Details

The perturbation of each coordinate is a linear combination of n_basis B-spline functions over the centreline abscissa with zero-mean Gaussian coefficients carrying an exponential autocorrelation. Because the field is zero-mean, the sample mean of the bundle stays on the true centreline.

Each axon carries per-point microstructure attributes as @point_data: curvature, torsion and the unit tangent components dir_x, dir_y, dir_z, computed from that axon's own geometry. If radius is a scalar it is stored per-streamline; if it is a length-N vector it is stored as a per-point radius.

Examples

cl <- generate_centerline(angle = 0.5, arm_length = 1,
                          interaction_length = 2, n_points = 100)
b <- create_axons(cl, n_axons = 20, n_basis = 8, variance = 0.02,
                  autocorrelation = 2, seed = 1)
fiber::is_bundle(b)      # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
b@n_streamlines          # 20
#> [1] 20
